IDENTITY_COLORS.$description: The Cardi identity palette, and now the source of the whole UI. Not to be confused with BRAND_COLORS in shared/theme/colors.ts, which maps 57 RETAILER brands to their own colours -- these three are OURS. Ink is the app icon field, the launch surface, the native splash background, the light-mode structure and every light-mode primary action; beam is the accent on the i, focus and selected states, and every dark-mode primary action; cream is the light-mode ground and the dark-mode body text. Story 21.2 migrated LIGHT_THEME_COLORS and DARK_THEME_COLORS onto these three, so they are no longer a parallel truth -- every theme value below is ink, beam, cream, or a tone derived from them. See docs/design/cardi/cardi-design-system.md.

CARD_COLORS.$description: 5-color virtual-logo palette for cards without an official logo. Story 21.2 deliberately left these values untouched: the Cardi accents, the CardColor union, mapHexToCardColor and the phone->watch wire contract move together in Story 21.2a.

NEUTRAL_COLORS.$description: White/black plus the slate neutral ramp. White and black are live (button labels, the barcode flash); the slate ramp has no consumers and is a candidate for removal once nothing in the repo can reach it.

LIGHT_THEME_COLORS.$description: Light theme color members -- Cardi Ink & Beam (Story 21.2). Ink structure on a cream ground, cards in pure white. Six keys share ink by design, not by oversight: Cardi colours no `success`, `warning`, `info` or `link` role, its only green is a card accent forbidden as chrome, and inventing a sixth hue would break the system's thesis that chrome stays quiet so 57 brand colours can be loud. Beam is NOT available as a light-mode foreground: it is 1.33:1 on cream and 1.52:1 on white, so it is a field that carries ink, never a mark drawn on a light ground -- it appears in the dark theme below instead. `textTertiary` is DARKER than the tone the rest of the ramp would suggest because it is real text -- placeholders, hints, empty-state subtitles -- not decoration, so it is held to AA (4.5:1) against every ground it is drawn on rather than to the 3:1 a decorative grey would get. The non-token statusBar literal is appended hand-authored in colors.ts.

DARK_THEME_COLORS.$description: Dark theme color members -- Cardi Ink & Beam (Story 21.2), OLED-optimized. True-black ground, ink cards, cream body text, and beam for every primary action. `onPrimary` is ink because beam must always carry ink text and never white -- colors.contrast.test.ts proves white-on-beam fails. `onError` is ink for the same reason: the dark error red is lifted far enough to clear AA on black that white no longer clears AA on IT (3.41:1), which is the trap an `error` token shared between fills and text sets. `primaryDark` (the pressed tone) lifts to cream rather than darkening beam, which the system forbids outright. The roles split here where they coincide in light: beam carries the ones that ask for action (`primary`, `link`, `warning`), cream the ones that only inform (`success`, `info`). The non-token statusBar literal is appended hand-authored in colors.ts.
